votes.motion: Approve the minutes of the September 1 and September 15, 2021 meetings.

votes.motion: Continue the Matthew Butterworth Request for a Determination hearing (188 Whalom Road) to the November 3 meeting.

votes.motion: Continue the Bryan Miner Request for a Determination hearing (35 Peninsula Drive) to November 3, 2021.
votes.quote: by a motion of rb and a second by jv with a unanimous vote to approve the motion.

votes.motion: Continue the Ray Clouthier hearing (37 Pearl Street) to November 3, 2021.
votes.quote: and what is new by rb and a second by ml with a unanimous vote to approve.

votes.motion: Issue an Order of Conditions for Cynthia Ritchie (137 Flynn Road), natural stone wall.
votes.quote: by a motion of jv and a second by jr with a unanimous vote to approve the motion.

votes.motion: Issue an Order of Conditions for Christopher and Suzanne DeGeorge (48 Pearl Street).
votes.quote: by a motion of jv and a second by cc with a unanimous vote by the commission to approve the motion.

votes.motion: Continue the Proctor Masonry Notice of Intent (203 Fire Road 16) to November 3, 2021.

votes.motion: Continue the MA Pleasant LLC Notice of Intent (101 Pleasant Street) to the November 3 meeting.
votes.quote: the hearing was continued to the november 3, 20921 meeting by a motion of rb and a second by cc with a unanimous vote to approve the motion.
